title: Console feature sequencing, enablement, and release coordination
creator: Aisha Raman
description:
Goal: Coordinate a staged release for the new Console dashboards + rollout controls + cost breakdown panels with a sequenced enablement plan for internal teams and customers. Scope: GA gating (feature flags, rollout UI, cost breakdown export), release notes, localized messaging, training modules for Support/Solutions/AE, and dashboards for success metrics. Excluded: backend quota billing changes (tracked elsewhere).

Acceptance criteria:
- Product and Design sign-off on final UI strings and screenshots (confluence page linked).
- Release notes drafted, reviewed by Legal and Comms, and approved three business days before ship.
- Training content produced (slides + short video + cheat sheet) and uploaded to Drive.
- Canary rollout plan defined with rollback criteria and automated metric checks (SLO degradation > 5% triggers rollback).
- Customer-facing docs updated and localized for EN/FR/DE.

Key stakeholders:
- PM: Aisha Raman (owner)
- Engineering lead: Priya Desai
- Design lead: Marco Alvarez
- Developer Relations: Lena Park
- Support enablement: Tom Nguyen
- Comms: Riley Hart

Rollout sequencing (high level):
1) Internal beta: enable flag for Redwood staff + a handful of pilot customers (1-week window).
2) Canary wave 1: 5% of eligible customers, monitor latency/cost KPIs for 72 hours.
3) Canary wave 2: 25% for 72 hours with expanded monitoring.
4) Full rollout with gradual ramp and comms.

Monitoring & KPIs:
- Console dashboard adoption (DAU of the new dashboards)
- Average latency for dashboard queries (target <200ms p95)
- Per-route token cost delta after enabling cost breakdowns
- Support ticket volume related to feature (target <2% of customers)

Risks & mitigations:
- Unexpected SLO regression: pre-defined rollback and fallback UI that hides advanced breakdowns.
- Confusing language in release notes: include screenshots and one-line examples in notes; design to approve all strings.
- Localization delays: prioritize EN and FR for first GA wave; push other locales as patch release.
